records.title: Internal links respond without error
records.steps: GET each internal link found on inspected pages (cap 150; cart-mutating, checkout and logout URLs skipped)
records.impact: Dead links break navigation and waste crawl budget.
records.fix: Update or remove each broken link; add URL redirects for moved pages.

records.title: Search returns products
records.steps: Look for a search entry point on the homepage; open /search?q=good (first word of a real product handle)
records.expected: Search entry point exists; results contain product links
records.actual: Entry point found; results page HTTP 200; 1 distinct product link(s)
records.impact: Shoppers who search cannot find products.
records.fix: Check the search template and that products are published to the Online Store channel.

records.title: Mobile menu opens
records.steps: At 375px, click the menu toggle (header button[aria-label*="menu" i]) and count visible links before/after
records.expected: More navigation links visible after activating the toggle
records.impact: Phone visitors cannot navigate the store.
records.fix: Confirm by hand first (heuristic). Then debug the drawer script/markup.

records.title: Collection page lists products
records.steps: Open /collections/all, count distinct product links
records.impact: Shoppers cannot browse from this collection to a product.
records.fix: Check the collection has published products and the product grid renders.

records.title: Product page shows title, price, media and purchase control
records.steps: Open /products/good-tee; read h1, price element, media count, add-to-cart form
records.actual: title "Good Tee", price "$25.00", media 1, purchase control present
records.impact: Shoppers lack information or the control needed to buy.
records.fix: Restore the missing block in the product template.

records.title: Product page shows title, price, media and purchase control
records.steps: Open /products/bad-mug; read h1, price element, media count, add-to-cart form
records.actual: title "Bad Mug", price "$12.00", media 1, purchase control present
records.impact: Shoppers lack information or the control needed to buy.
records.fix: Restore the missing block in the product template.

records.title: Add to cart works
records.steps: Read /cart.js item_count; click the add-to-cart button; poll /cart.js for up to 8 s (up to 3 products tried)
records.impact: Nobody can buy: the purchase journey stops at the product page.
records.fix: Reproduce by hand; check the product form script, variant availability and console errors on the product page.

records.title: Cart shows the added item
records.steps: Open /cart; look for the added product (link or title)
records.actual: HTTP 200; product link found; title text found
records.impact: Shoppers cannot review their order before checkout.
records.fix: Check the cart template renders line items.

records.title: Checkout is reachable from the cart
records.steps: Click the checkout control on /cart (fallback: open /checkout). Stop at the first checkout page; enter nothing.
records.expected: Browser lands on a checkout URL
records.actual: Control clicked; final URL via cart control: http://127.0.0.1:44267/checkouts/cn/[REDACTED]/information
records.impact: Shoppers cannot start checkout.
records.fix: Reproduce by hand; check the cart form, checkout button and any script intercepting the submit.

records.title: Variant selection changes the selected variant
records.steps: Open /products/good-tee; change the variant picker (select -> "good-tee-l"); read the form's [name=id]
records.impact: Shoppers may buy a different size or colour than the one they picked.
records.fix: Check the variant picker script updates the hidden id input (console errors, custom picker app).

records.title: Price updates when the variant changes
records.steps: Change the variant (select -> "good-tee-l"); read the visible price
records.impact: Shoppers see one price and are charged another.
records.fix: Check the variant change handler re-renders the price block.

records.title: Quantity selector adds the chosen quantity
records.steps: Open /products/good-tee; set quantity to 2; click add to cart; poll /cart.js
records.impact: Shoppers buying several units get the wrong quantity.
records.fix: Check the quantity input is inside the product form and named "quantity".

records.title: Cart total matches its lines
records.steps: Read /cart.js; sum line prices; compare with total_price and with the amounts shown on /cart
records.expected: Sum of lines = total_price, and the total is shown on /cart
records.actual: lines 7500 cents, total_price 7500 cents; total found on /cart
records.impact: Shoppers see a total that does not match what they will pay.
records.fix: Check the cart template prints cart.total_price and that discount apps adjust lines consistently.

records.title: Changing a cart quantity updates the cart
records.steps: Set line 1 quantity 3 -> 4 via cart page quantity input; read /cart.js
records.impact: Shoppers cannot adjust quantities before checkout.
records.fix: The cart API works but the theme cart quantity control did not: check the cart quantity script.

records.title: Removing a cart line empties it
records.steps: Remove line 1 via cart page remove control; read /cart.js
records.impact: Shoppers cannot take an unwanted item out of the cart.
records.fix: The cart API works but the theme remove control did not: check the cart remove script.
